description: Actual Docker jq display of the existing PasswordHasher probe JSON; no new build or probe execution for this capture
commands:
# รันที่ root ของ Team Notes checkout เดิม
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
./scripts/lab-tools jq '{framework,identityAssemblyVersion,compatibilityMode,oldIterations,currentIterations,passedCount,totalCount,passed}' labs/password-storage/result.json
./scripts/lab-tools jq -r '.checks[] | (if .Passed then "[PASS] " else "[FAIL] " end) + .Name + " => " + .Observed' labs/password-storage/result.json

result.scope: In-memory PasswordHasher verification and work-factor upgrade only
limitations: No application, database, authentication session or seed data was changed.
No MD5 compatibility branch, persistent migration or password reset flow was implemented.
Iteration counts are explicit exercise policies, not a hardware benchmark or universal setting.
